correctness.rationale: Stationary four-cycle Fourier decomposition gives a two-exponential/oscillatory covariance. Exact Poisson immigration-death filtering yields the full spectrum with shot noise. After x=(omega/a)^2 normalization its derivative is the negative of a polynomial Q with all strictly positive nonconstant coefficients; hence one positive root precisely when gamma²>4a²+32a³/(3beta). Exact n=2,3 and reversible-generator spectral decompositions establish the scoped minimality. Finite exact rational and independent resolvent checks corroborate, not replace proof.

value.rationale: A sharp, analytically falsifiable inequality predicts when four-stage nonequilibrium promoter turnover produces a spectral peak without feedback and proves unimodality. Explicit n<=3 and reversible obstructions distinguish architectural mechanisms, beyond an integrated variance computation or an arbitrary example. The parameter threshold may guide discrimination of promoter-state dynamics in frequency-resolved single-cell assays.
